bullets.text: Companywide profitability improved; Personal Lines CR was 91.8 (Agency 90.5; Direct 93.1); Commercial Lines CR 89.6; Property CR 96.6, which included nearly seven points of amortization.
Companywide NPW +12% YOY; NEP +13%; Personal Lines NPW and NEP both +13%; Commercial Lines NPW flat while NEP +18%; Property NPW +27% and NEP +13%.

HomeQuote Explorer launched in eight states, testing online homeowners quoting with countrywide rollout planned for 2017; Robinsons new business applications grew over 50% YOY and PIFs increased over 25%.
Snapshot mobile app launched in four states with countrywide rollout expected by year-end 2017; over half of Direct eligible customers chose mobile; Direct Snapshot quote take rate rose to 35%.

Retention gains declined slightly as renewing customers absorbed late 2016 rate actions; headwind may persist through 2017; Property new apps +31% and PIFs +17%; Robinsons retention increased nearly 25% over three years.
Total portfolio return 1.7% (equity 6.1%, fixed income 1.1%); issued $850M of 4.125% 30-year notes in April to redeem 6.70% debentures; debt-to-total capital temporarily exceeds 30% ceiling.

Vehicle catastrophe losses were high relative to historical averages; March catastrophe activity elevated Property CR; aggregate stop-loss reinsurance agreement limits current-year loss and LAE ratio at 63, excluding named storms and liability.

Commercial Lines lifted several underwriting restrictions after enhancing segmentation; new policy application growth continued negative; business applications showed early signs of improvement; Commercial Lines CR was 89.6.

Increased planned 2017 media spend given strong Direct auto profitability; Direct new auto applications turned positive in March, which Progressive believes occurred because federal tax refund backlogs cleared; media spend ramped up.

Signed agreements to exit Australia, expecting a fourth-quarter 2017 sale to The Hollard Insurance Company due to unmet profitability goals; Progressive believes it is better suited focusing on U.S. Destination Era opportunities.
